verdict.rationale: Google Cloud's Infrastructure Manager offers a first-party managed IaC surface: you define infrastructure declaratively with Terraform and create preview deployments to see the impact of changes before applying them. That covers the template side of the story. The evidence shows nothing for the typed CDK-style framework or for state and rollback semantics. Missing for 10: a first-party typed CDK-style framework, documented state management and rollback semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration of Infrastructure Manager.
